## Core Platform Overview
CityHaldwani operates solely as an independent classified advertising platform with a zero-tolerance policy for fraud, scams, or unverified listings. All listed companions undergo mandatory photo and video verification before approval. The platform strictly enforces a **"No Online Advance Payment"** policy—all transactions are handled directly with companions via cash on delivery upon in-person verification.

- **Platform URL:** https://www.cityhaldwani.in/
